name: Wizzle Brassbolts
summary: Wizzle Brassbolts is an Alliance gnome engineer stationed alongside his fellow tinkerers out on the salt flats of Thousand Needles. Working with the gnomish racing team at the Mirage Raceway, he seeks durable local materials to reinforce their experimental rocket cars.

sections.title: Tinkering on the Salt Flats
sections.body: Out in the shimmering heat of the Shimmering Flats, the rivalry between gnomish and goblin engineering takes the form of high-speed rocket car races. Wizzle Brassbolts works as part of the gnomish raceway crew, striving to keep their vehicles intact against blistering speeds and abrasive salt. To bolster their machines, he recruits adventurers to hunt the local wildlife—such as the sturdy turtles wandering the basin—harvesting thick shells and natural plating to reinforce the team's chassis.

sections.title: Friends in Distant Places
sections.body: Wizzle maintains close ties with friends across the continents, including fellow tinkerers and aerial scouts like Pilot Longbeard. Whether trading supplies, sharing schematics, or sending couriers back and forth with custom-machined parts, Wizzle keeps the gnomish team supplied despite their remote, inhospitable testing ground on the Shimmering Flats.

faq.q: Where can I find Wizzle Brassbolts?
faq.answer: Wizzle Brassbolts is located at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats, in the southeastern reaches of Thousand Needles. He stands among the gnomish pit crew and their machinery.

faq.q: Why is Wizzle collecting turtle shells?
faq.answer: High-speed racing across the abrasive salt flats wrecks lightweight metal plating. Wizzle uses the rock-hard shells of native salt-flat turtles to craft reinforced, heat-resistant armor and components for the gnomish team's race cars.

The Brassbolts are a family of gnomish tinkerers and machinists. They collaborate on engineering ventures and keep in contact across distant Alliance and neutral outposts, sharing parts and technical expertise.

faq.q: Is Wizzle friendly to Horde players?
faq.answer: While the Mirage Raceway itself maintains a neutral truce between the goblin and gnome racing syndicates, Wizzle Brassbolts is aligned with the Alliance and offers his tasks specifically to Alliance adventurers.

angles.text: Wizzle exemplifies the gnomish engineering philosophy: pushing high-velocity machines to their limits and relying on unusual structural reinforcements when metal sheets fail.
Gnomes visiting the Shimmering Flats will find in Wizzle a kindred spirit, stubbornly determined to defeat the reckless contraptions of the Steamwheedle goblins using superior craft.
